caseName: Duke Power Co. v. Carolina Environmental Study Group, Inc.
caseNameFull: Duke Power Co. v. Carolina Environmental Study Group, Inc. and United States Nuclear Regulatory Commission v. Carolina Environmental Study Group, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. W. D. N. C. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 937.] Motions of Southeastern Legal Foundation and Pacific Legal Foundation for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Motion of the Solicitor General for additional, time for oral argument granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that, purpose. Appellees also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
